function.name: request_ride
function.description: Book a ride to a place.

vehicle.description: BIKE, AUTO or CAB. AUTO when the user names no vehicle.

destination.description: The place name in English, or empty when the user names no place.

function.name: search_marketplace
function.description: Find shops, food, products or skilled people nearby.

query.description: What to find, in English, e.g. sugar, plumber, biryani.

function.name: compare
function.description: Compare providers for something, cheapest or best first.

function.name: show_activity
function.description: Show my rides, orders and requests.

function.name: find_content
function.description: Find posts, videos, photos or files people shared, or a person's profile, in Explore.

kind.description: VIDEO, IMAGE, FILE, PEOPLE for a person's profile, or ALL for any post.

query.description: The topic or person's name exactly as the user said it; empty when none.

function.name: post_request
function.description: Ask the neighbourhood for something that is not listed.

what.description: What the user is looking for, in English.

function.name: go_online
function.description: A driver goes online to receive rides.

function.name: become_provider
function.description: Start listing a shop, skill or vehicle.

function.name: confirm_pending
function.description: The user says yes to the action waiting for confirmation.

function.name: cancel_pending
function.description: The user says no to the action waiting for confirmation.

function.name: help
function.description: Anything that is not one of the other actions.
